page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with line numbers (5, 10, 15 ... 35) printed beside it. Notes in the left margin, cut off at the edge. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Primi præcepti virtutes.
main_text.l: cil-2. Fides siue Fiducia in Deo.
10. Obedientia erga Deum & studium placendi Deo.
12. Inuocatio Dei in corde, siue interna illa.
main_text.head: Secundi præcepti virtutes.
Tertij præcepti virtutes.
Quarti præcepti virtutes.
main_text.p: Probitas est, quâ de homine sentimus vt par est, ipsum-que rectè diligimus. Ea est posita in dilectione sui ipsius & proximi iuxta præceptum 5. 6. 7. 8. 9. 10. hoc modo.

page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed beside the column and are shown at the start of their lines. The "30" beside the heading "Quarti præcepti virtutes." is not shown. Left-margin fragments are cut off at the scan edge and are doubtful: "cito", "cil-", "or-", "re, 5", "edi-" are read from the cropped edge. The "ent 10" fragment is also cut off and is not transcribed. The running head is read as BIBLICUS. Text is set in an uneven, worn type, so letters such as s and f are read from context, and "studium" and "Refipiscentia" are as printed.
